capabilities: Aggregate completed checkboxes and tags from Daily Notes
Visualize trends in stacked bar charts, line charts, and an activity heatmap
Filter data by weekly, monthly, or yearly periods
Export the selected period's aggregated data to a CSV file in the vault
Configure which folders, headings, tags, and charts the dashboard uses
extras: Assumes daily note filenames start with a YYYY-MM-DD date; otherwise falls back to the file's creation time, which may not reflect the intended note date.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize checkbox and tag data from Daily Notes as trends over time.
summary: Dashboard view that charts checkbox completions and tag usage from Daily Notes over weekly, monthly, or yearly periods.
